# Stage 9: divergence, tax dollars, duplex yields (generated by src/avm/stage9_divergence.py)

Every figure per parcel is a MODEL ESTIMATE with its 80% range. Frozen primary model (public data), valued at Jan 1 2025, compared with roll 2025.

Tax rate: 20.8 per $1,000 (net, CONFIRMED (Owen, 2026-10-20) from the Milwaukee County comparative rate table; gross 22.42). School levy credit: included through the net rate: it reduces each bill in proportion to assessed value (Wis. Stat. 79.10), so the net rate is the marginal tax per assessed dollar. Excluded: the first dollar credit (every improved parcel) and the lottery and gaming credit (owner-occupied principal dwellings only); both are computed on value only up to a statutory cap (Wis. Stat. 79.10(9)(bm), (9)(bn), (11)), so above the cap they do not grow with the assessment. Note: 22.93 is the City of Milwaukee's 2024 rate in the same county table, not a 2025 figure.

## Group tax shifts, with the direction-aware guardrail

Shift = median of log(assessed / market-based fair share). Model bias = the frozen primary's mean log error on CV 2021-2024 sales in the group minus its citywide mean; corrected shift = shift + bias (bootstrap CI from independent draws). Sales check = assessor median ratio on 2025 city-tract sales in the group / the citywide median ratio (model-free). A claim needs (a) the corrected CI to exclude zero, (b) the sales check CI to exclude zero (as a percent) in the same direction, and (c) both to hold with tier-specific (tercile) time adjustment.
